summary: Typing test over a pixel keyboard where each key flashes, ripples to its neighbours, builds heat with use and turns red on a miss.

events.name: done
events.description: Fires when the typed text matches the target line. `accuracy` is a whole percentage.

methods.description: Clears the input, the timer, the score and the key heat, makes the field editable again and focuses it.

keyboard.action: Flash the matching key and count the keystroke; a wrong character flashes red and lowers accuracy.

accessibility: The target line is read as one piece of visually hidden text, "Type this: pixels glow when you type them"; the coloured characters are `aria-hidden`. The input has `aria-label="Typing test"` and is described by the target line.
The keyboard canvas has `role="img"` and `aria-label="Keyboard heatmap"`.

The WPM and accuracy line updates silently while you type; a visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region announces the result once the line is complete. The input then turns read-only and keeps focus; Reset is a native button.
motion: With reduced motion, only the completion sparks and the rolling status text are suppressed; key flashes and ripples still play.
notes: The target sentence is fixed demo content. WPM counts correct keystrokes divided by five per minute from the first key.
The heatmap covers letters and the space bar; the key letters are drawn in the page font. Reset also clears the key heat. The canvas is 104px tall.
